assessment.goal: Add a light theme while retaining the existing dark theme.
assessment.summary: The app will continue to default to dark mode, persist the user's selected theme, and offer theme controls through both a quick toggle and Settings. Light styling will cover all interface states, using neutral white and light-slate surfaces while preserving existing blue-violet accents. Video tiles and media overlays will remain dark. The light theme must meet WCAG AA contrast requirements with visible focus indicators and readable controls.
openQuestions: Exact placement and presentation of the quick theme toggle
Where and how the saved theme preference should be persisted
